title: A sleep sets the pause-time speed baseline in the metrics test
notes: TestAWorkerReportsItsJobWhileItRuns (metrics_integration_test.go) sleeps 1 s after jobs pauses, scrapes the speed, sleeps 5 s, scrapes again and requires them equal to 1e-9. On a slow runner ffmpeg progress still in the pipe after the 1 s can change the speed between the two scrapes, which fails a right build. The comment says it is read 'by now'. Reading only. Closed at the pivot: Rule 17: says nothing a viewer or operator would notice (a test's strength, a refactor, tooling or an internal cost). Reopen with the effect someone sees and its evidence.
